QuestInfo.name: [Edelstein] Big Sister's Birthday Party 2
QuestInfo.0: #b#p2152009##k has more things left to do.
QuestInfo.1: #p2152009# wants you to tell her older sister to come home for her birthday, no matter what it takes. You don't even know who #p2152009#'s sister is... When you asked #p2152009#, she said the two of them look so similar that you won't have any problem finding her. Find #b#p2152009#'s big sister#k in town.
QuestInfo.2: #p2152009#'s big sister was #p2152004#. The calm, poised, cold #p2152004# and the tomboy #p2152009# are sisters... They look and act nothing like each other!

0.0: Now we just have to put this strawberry on top of the cake. But first, we have to go get my sister. She's so busy that she doesn't always make it home. So I need to make sure she'll be home on her birthday. Please go talk to her!

yes.0: Huh?! All this time and you don't know who my #bsister#k is? But we look so much alike! Well, you should be able to #bfind her around town#k, so go look for her!

no.0: You don't want to? But I feel so awkward asking her myself...

1.0: What can I do for you? Are you hurt? What? #p2152009# has a message for me?\r\n#L0# #b(You tell her that #p2152009# wants her to come home for her birthday.)#l\n#k
1.1: Oh, is it my birthday already? Tell #p2152009# I'll definitely make time for her. Thank you for delivering her message.

npc.0: Haven't you found my #bsister#k yet? That's strange, she looks just like me! Maybe not as similar as the twins #p2152008# and #p2153003# but still very close! We especially have the same...#bhair color#k!
